hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In my new role as a maid at the House of Lights, I find myself in the dimly lit corridor between the rooms. The air is thick with the scent of lavender and the warmth of the hearth is just out of reach. Suddenly, footsteps approach. My pulse races as goosebumps rise on my skin. Will they discover me, or will I find an excuse to stay hidden? #18thCentury #PeriodDrama #HistoricalRomance #BettyRyal #MaidLife #POV
